def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate the solid divider and split into corresponding panels.
    if any(len(set(row)) == 1 for row in grid):
        d = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:d], grid[d + 1:]
        shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        background = next(iter(shared))
        return [
            [3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(len(a))
        ]
    else:
        d = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)))
        a = [row[:d] for row in grid]
        b = [row[d + 1:] for row in grid]
        shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        background = next(iter(shared))
        return [
            [3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background for c in range(d)]
            for r in range(h)
        ]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []

    # A divider is a solid row or column whose color appears nowhere else,
    # with equal-sized panels on either side.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h - r - 1:
            color = grid[r][0]
            if all(grid[i][j] != color for i in range(h) if i != r for j in range(w)):
                candidates.append(("row", r))

    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and c == w - c - 1:
            color = grid[0][c]
            if all(grid[r][j] != color for r in range(h) for j in range(w) if j != c):
                candidates.append(("col", c))

    axis, d = candidates[0]
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:d], grid[d + 1:]
        shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        background = min(shared)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background for c in range(w)]
                for r in range(d)]

    a = [row[:d] for row in grid]
    b = [row[d + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    background = min(shared)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background for c in range(d)]
            for r in range(h)]
